description: Time series for one standardized financial concept for one company (e.g. 'revenue', 'net_income', 'eps_diluted', 'total_assets'), from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings with history back to 2015. Use for a single metric's trend; use get_financials instead for full statements per period, and list_financial_concepts for the valid concept slugs. Read-only; no API key. Each point carries the period start/end, fiscal year and period labels, the value and unit, and per-value provenance (form, filed date, accession number); duplicates and restatements are resolved latest-filed-wins, and values computed from reported components carry derived:true plus a 'derived:' tag — including Q4 points derived as fiscal year minus Q1–Q3. The series spans a company's predecessor chain when a ticker moved between filers, and the response carries a staleness flag when SEC submissions show a newer filing than the stored facts. `period` defaults to all (annual plus quarterly points); `limit` defaults to 40 points, max 200.

cik.description: SEC CIK number (takes precedence over ticker)

period.description: Annual points, quarterly points, or all. Default: all

name: get_metric_history
